claims.text: Conductive wood has been made as a structural material with a load-bearing function.
Metals and carbon-based compounds are the traditional conductor choices for shielding, flexible electronics and energy storage.
You have studied the structural dependence of PFAS oxidation in a boron-doped diamond electrochemical system.

draft.title: Conductive wood electrodes for electrochemical PFAS oxidation
